verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same problems. The pink brush-stroke underline is pulled off the headline and floats alone at the top. A duplicate stroke sits at the bottom, almost on the canvas edge. The crane photo, a key image, has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the bottom-left corner. The brick photo is a small floating rectangle with a large empty gap below it, so the layout looks scattered rather than designed. The only visible difference is that the top stroke is slightly wider in A, which doesn't change the verdict.
